$comment: Rule engine config for the AIMess Scenario Validation Framework. A ruleset declares which side-effects a CLASS of business action MUST and SHOULD fan out. Per-action overrides live in registry.json (an effect may be explicitly waived with a written reason). See docs/SCENARIO_VALIDATION_FRAMEWORK.md.

ciGate.$comment: Build fails if any action ends FAILED at a risk >= failAtRisk.

member_mutation.description: A user is added/removed/role-changed in a community or group. The affected user MUST be notified.

privileged_action.description: An admin/moderator mutates a user account (ban/suspend/delete). MUST be audited, the user notified, and live sessions invalidated.

message_send.description: A chat/community message is sent. MUST persist and broadcast in real time; SHOULD wake offline recipients.

social_request.description: A friend/social request is sent or accepted. The counterparty MUST be notified.

lifecycle_self.description: A self-initiated lifecycle action (create/join). The actor already knows; cross-service wiring still required.

media_lifecycle.description: A media upload completes / is rejected by scan. The uploader SHOULD learn the outcome out-of-band.

notification_lifecycle.description: A notification is created/read/deleted. The change MUST reach the user's devices and update the badge.
